what: An orange gradient plate laid over the dark CTA section is revealed from 0 → 1 as the section rises. While the section’s top edge goes from ‹ screen bottom − section height × .3 › to ‹ screen bottom − section height × 1.05 ›, the target goes 0 → 1. The actual value follows .08 of the remaining gap each frame, so it keeps spreading a little after scrolling stops. When the reveal passes .8, a large glow ellipse (1440 × 284) at the section’s bottom edge rises into place from 70% below. The value is exposed as --fx-reveal, so other things such as the button border color change along with it (gray to white via color-mix)

options.from: Where target 0 sits (share of section height), default .3
options.to: Spot that becomes target 1 (share of section height), default 1.05
options.[data-fx-part=glow]: Gradient panel to be revealed (child, the consuming CSS overrides background)

from.where: All pages .promo (PEACH WITH US — a black section bleeds into an orange gradient, button border goes gray → white)
